IP address?
A logical numerical address that identifies a device on a network so data can be routed to it.
Subnet mask?
A value that identifies which bits of an IP address form the network part and which form the host part.
DHCP?
Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol: a service that automatically assigns IP addresses and network settings to devices.
Network address translation (NAT)?
A router technique that maps private IP addresses to a public IP address so many devices can share one public address.
Packet switching?
A method of transmission in which data is split into packets that travel independently across shared links and are reassembled at the destination.
Circuit switching?
A method of transmission in which a dedicated path is set up and reserved between sender and receiver for the whole communication.
